name: 159-key-window-cap-reintroduced
old:
end = j
    while j > 0 and text[j - 1] in _KEY_CHARS:
        j -= 1
    return text[j:end]
new:
end = j
    low = max(0, sep_index - 64)  # mutant: 恢复 64 字符回看窗口
    while j > low and text[j - 1] in _KEY_CHARS:
